name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Russian chemist, professor, and rector who founded the molecular layering method and the scientific school of Chemistry of highly organized substances.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Russian chemist and student of Aleskovskii who co-developed the molecular layering method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Educational and research institute in Leningrad/St. Petersburg focused on chemical engineering and technology.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Major university in Leningrad/St. Petersburg where Aleskovskii served as rector and professor.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow after graduation.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Premier scientific academy of the Soviet Union.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Proletarskaya
summary: Station in the Rostov region of the USSR where Kol'tsov was born.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Chemical synthesis method for thin films and surface modification developed by Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov.

name: Framework Hypothesis
summary: Theoretical concept regarding solid state chemistry proposed by Aleskovskii.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist who invented atomic layer epitaxy independently.

name: Ministry of Higher Education of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic
aliases: Ministry of Higher Education of the RSFSR
summary: Government body that founded the Chemical assembly of materials program.
